item.title: Customizing Layer5 Cloud Deployment with Helm
item.description:
Requirements 🔗

The layer5-cloud chart installs the Layer5 Cloud server and, as subcharts, Kratos and Hydra. The defaults below are those of chart version 0.2.0, which ships with Layer5 Cloud v1.0.278. Run helm show values layer5/layer5-cloud to print the defaults of the version you install. For the install procedure, see Deploying Layer5 Cloud.

Values 🔗

The chart writes env.* values into one ConfigMap and one Secret, and the server pod reads both as environment variables. Sensitive values go to the Secret. Any change to either rolls the server pods.

item.title: Client IP Address Resolution
item.description:
Release availability

These settings apply to Layer5 Cloud releases that include system-wide client IP resolution. Earlier releases do not read the CLIENT_IP_* settings.

Layer5 Cloud determines a single client address for every request it serves. That one address is used everywhere a caller is identified by address:

  • rate limits that key on the caller’s network (for example anonymous Meshery Server handshakes and OAuth dynamic client registration),
  • the access log,
  • the IP block list,
  • the per-address budgets for diagnostics and support submissions,
  • the client address Cloud forwards to its identity services (Ory Hydra and Kratos).

The setting is system-wide. It applies to every route, not to one feature, and it is independent of whether you use a CDN at all.
